title: Handle missing .agent/ files gracefully in rocket status
description: If tasks.json doesn't exist, show a helpful message instead of the dashboard. If LOG.md or history/ are missing, show N/A for those sections. No unhandled exceptions.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket status in a directory without .agent/ shows 'No tasks found — run rocket init' and exits 0
Missing LOG.md shows 'N/A' for recent activity and current focus task
No stack traces visible to user

steps.details: In statusCommand: if (!await fs.pathExists(path.join(process.cwd(), '.agent', 'tasks.json'))) { console.log('No tasks found — run `rocket init` to set up your project.'); return }

steps.description: Use empty fallbacks for missing LOG.md and history/
steps.details: readRecentActivity and readHistoryStats already return empty values for missing files (from their implementations in TASK-133 and TASK-134). Verify this is actually the case.
Wrap the entire statusCommand body in try/catch: catch (err) { console.error('Status error:', err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)); process.exit(1) }
